evals.prompt: I need to scrape all product listings from a competitor's e-commerce site and extract the product names, prices, and descriptions into structured JSON. The site uses React so pages are rendered client-side. Walk me through how to do this. Describe the calls and their parameters; do not run them. Use the web-scraping skill.
evals.expected_output: Should recommend firecrawl_map to discover URLs, then firecrawl_agent with urls, strictConstrainToURLs and a schema for structured extraction (polling firecrawl_agent_status; firecrawl_scrape has no json format), or firecrawl_agent without urls for unknown URLs. Should mention waitFor (firecrawl_scrape) or agent navigation for JS-rendered pages. Should cover the full pipeline: discover URLs → filter → extract structured data → transform.
expectations: The answer discovers the product URLs with firecrawl_map
The answer extracts the fields with firecrawl_agent using urls, strictConstrainToURLs and a schema, and polls firecrawl_agent_status
The answer addresses the client-side rendering, for example waitFor on firecrawl_scrape or the agent navigating the pages
The answer does not use formats json or jsonOptions on firecrawl_scrape
The answer says to leave out urls and strictConstrainToURLs when the URLs are not known
